method: Two real Vite builds (current and -next-test) at one controlled origin; UI checks, legal aim/paddle input and natural collection. SW first-activation delay, install503 and localStorage failure are explicit non-gameplay fault fixtures. No ball/target/score/time injection. Other tab also uses a naturally collected shot. This test is not a human win rate.
checks: controlled first-activation delay is exercised
current version is readable on mobile
first install does not claim a newer version
first offline install reuses the browser original PNG download
pending check keeps forward keyboard focus inside the dialog
pending check keeps reverse keyboard focus inside the dialog
failed install leaves the current ball and board untouched
notification does not pause, reload or replace the live game
update is unavailable during an unfinished whole run
waiting worker retains the paused body and scores
a real natural challenge win is recorded before update
the write-failure fixture really leaves the earned result unsaved
second tab naturally returns to aim with an unfinished run
between balls still protects the whole run
activation waits for a sibling held save lock
storage failure refuses update and keeps the completed game
accepted update loads the new version without closing the other tab
an idle sibling also waits for its own explicit choice
a sibling menu write merges the other tab earned stars
reload-needed branch keeps a sibling earned result
earned stars survive
sound and effect preferences survive
another tab does not refresh or discard its unfinished run
another tab can offer a deferred reload after controller takeover
no newer badge after the accepted upgrade
preceding immutable resources remain available to the old tab
offline reload uses the new shell and original PNG
update reused the original hashed PNG without downloading again
only complete current and preceding cache generations remain
no runtime exceptions in either actual page
